```{r}
#| include: true
if (!exists("p.target") || !length(p.target)) p.target <- "mean"
if (!exists("Da.target") || !length(Da.target))  Da.target  <- sort(Da.gmdp)
if (!exists("MODELS", inherits = FALSE)) MODELS <- c(rigid = "Rigid Models", flexible = "Flexible Models", ensemble = "Ensemble Models")
if (!exists("IDn.target") || !length(IDn.target)) IDn.target <- names(MODELS)
MODELS <- MODELS[names(MODELS) %in% IDn.target]
if (!exists("PSA_Units") || !length(PSA_Units))  PSA_Units  <- "cm/s2"
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- readCaption("fig.kmax")
if (!exists("CAP.MCE", inherits = FALSE)) CAP.MCE <- readCaption("fig.kmax.MCE")
TR.label <- prettyNum(TR.gmdp, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)
IDg.target <- IDg.gmdp
IDm.target <- IDm.gmdp
SiteID.caption <- .requireOneTarget(
  .currentTarget("siteID.target"), "siteID.target", "kmax figure caption"
)
```

}
rm(IDn)
